note: Hand-written expectations for the R02 (Cain) enemy sidecar. The checker compares the generated manifest, pixel source and PNGs against THIS file, never against the manifest's own claims. Values follow docs/art/r02-design-task.md and docs/harness/unity-r02-plan.md, resolved against the reviewed art 03 contract (pivot [16,1] like every 03 enemy instead of the task's candidate [16,4]; see README).
pivotSpace: pixel-edge coordinates, origin at the bottom-left corner of one frame cell, x right, y up
frameLayout: one horizontal strip per animation; frame i occupies x = i*cell.w .. (i+1)*cell.w, full height; no padding

flip.note: flip once on the enemy's parent transform (or its single renderer); the art always faces right

alphaPolicies.binary: alpha is 0 or 255 only; RGB is 0 wherever alpha is 0

frameChange.rule: an animated strip (fps > 0, frames > 1) must not repeat the previous frame; a looping strip also compares its last frame with its first. Reusing a non-adjacent frame is allowed.

edgeMargin.why: no opaque pixel in the outer 1 px ring of a frame, so Point filtering and flipX never cut the outline; ground sprites still stand on the foot row = cell.h - 1 - pivot.y

reviewFonts.note: Fonts used only to label review boards (never inside a sprite). Package = the sibling outline font sidecar; the checker resolves it with --font-root.
